description: A Kivy application providing an interactive demo for tuning DampedScrollEffect parameters in a ScrollView, including sliders for parameters, live updates, and content population.

classes.name: ColoredLabel
classes.description: A custom Label with a colored background, supporting dynamic rectangle updates on position and size.

classes.name: DampedScrollEffectTuningApp
classes.description: Main Kivy App class managing the UI, effect parameter updates, content population, and reset functionality.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Initializes the app, loads UI from kv string, populates content, and schedules effect storage.

methods.name: _store_effect
methods.description: Stores reference to the scroll view's effect and logs initial parameters.

methods.name: _populate_content
methods.description: Populates the scroll view with header, items, and footer for testing.

methods.name: update_rubber_band
methods.description: Updates the rubber band coefficient of the effect.

methods.name: update_spring_stiffness
methods.description: Updates the spring stiffness and recalculates critical damping.

methods.name: update_spring_mass
methods.description: Updates the spring mass and recalculates critical damping.

methods.name: get_critical_damping
methods.description: Calculates and returns the critical damping value based on current spring parameters.

methods.name: reset_defaults
methods.description: Resets all effect parameters and sliders to default values.
